scope: Finite numerical falsification around the exact fifth endpoint only. Exact claims are confined to the endpoint, exact interval box, exact rails/graph/cell atlas, and exact verifiers.

fixed_geometry_center_test.method: mixed-integer linear feasibility using affine face, vertex and four edge-cone primitives
fixed_geometry_center_test.status: numerically infeasible even at zero margin for the exact fifth incidence
fixed_geometry_center_test.warning: This is a numerical HiGHS result, not an exact impossibility theorem.

observed_behavior: One-point, two-point, deletion, support-plane and vertex-replacement operations either retain the single S-H packet or transfer/multiply equilibrium pairs. No strict (1,1,0) state was observed.

first_unclassified_topology.name: coupled two-cell bistellar S-H replacement
first_unclassified_topology.required_incidence: Replace the stable limiting edge (198,224) and the saddle edge (229,247) inside one triangular-prismatic/octahedral volume complex, or create a new shared interior edge incident to both stars, so the face-foot and beta death walls overlap before any U-H birth.
first_unclassified_topology.required_controls: At least two independent local incidence coordinates plus the two rail antibirth directions and three dependent translations.
